title: Helensburgh, Cardross, Dumbarton Cyclepath Active Travel Route - Phase 3: Developed & Technical Design
description: This tender is for Phase 3 of the Helensburgh, Cardross and Dumbarton Cyclepath; linking the Helensburgh Waterfront segregated cycleway (OS Grid NS 29598 82259) to the existing section of the cyclepath adjacent to the A814 at the Red Burn (OS Grid NS 31655 81112), near the north-east corner of Morrisons Supermarket site, and will build upon the concept design developed for the majority of the route (Civic Engineers, 2025). title: Rygge Munitions Storage rea Expansion
description: The purpose of this amendment is to extend the deadline for submission of proposals to 02 October 2026, to include clauses 52.233-1, 52.233-3, and 252.243-7002, and to provide revisions to the RFP in response to RFIs received. All amended language within the solicitation will be bolded and highlighted where possible for visibility......................................................................................................................PROJECT TITLE: RYGGE MUNITIONS STORAGE AREA EXPANSIONPROJECT LOCATION: RYGGE, NORWAYTHIS CONSTRUCTION PROJECT WILL BE A COMPETITIVE, FIRM-FIXED PRICE DESIGN-BID-BUILD CONTRACT PROCURED VIA A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP) IN ACCORDANCE WITH FAR PARTS 15 AND 36 AND THE TRADEOFF SOURCE SELECTION PROCESS. THIS IS AN UNRESTRICTED (FULL-AND-OPEN COMPETITION) RFP WITH A BRAND-NAME REQUIREMENT UNDER NAICS CODE 236220. THE SMALL BUSINESS SIZE STANDARD FOR THIS NAICS CODE IS $45,000,000.00.The United States Corps of Engineers Europe District has a requirement on behalf of the United States Air Force (USAF) to build and extend the munitions storage area (MSA) on Rygge Air Station in support of USAF contingency operations in Norway. The project includes the construction of 20 ammunition storage magazines (earth-covered magazines, or ECMs) to accommodate a total Net Explosive Weight (NEW) of 3,000,000 pounds. A standard ammunition storage magazine design which supports up to a maximum capacity of 165,000 pounds NEW will be used for all 20 magazine/bunkers. Supporting facilities include one concrete munitions assembly pad, one stuff on-off pad, gravel roads, bermed areas, lighting, security fencing surmounted by barbed wire, and utility connections for communications and electrical. This project is in direct support of the European Deterrence Initiative (EDI) and the Supplementary Defense Cooperation Agreement (SDCA) between the United States and the Government of Norway, and is intended to be compatible with applicable NATO, DoD, Air Force, and host-nation design standards.

title: Social and emotional robot
description: Social and emotional robot The procurement consists of one (1) programmable and interactive social and emotional humanoid/service robot. The total value of the procurement shall not exceed EUR 75,000 (VAT 0%). The robot shall be designed for safe indoor operation and human interaction. It must support Finnish-language communication and be capable of facilitating social interaction, autonomous activities, emotional engagement, and the safe handling of objects. The robot must be suitable for educational, guidance, rehabilitation, and student support environments. The primary purpose of the procurement is to support Care Assistant Education by providing students with hands-on experience in healthcare and welfare technologies, social robotics, communication, guidance, and technology-assisted care. The robot will also be used in simulation-based learning and to familiarise students with technologies commonly encountered in modern working life. In addition, the robot will be available for multidisciplinary use across the contracting authority's educational programmes and support services. It will function as a shared pedagogical resource that promotes communication, participation, digital skills, and familiarity with emerging technologies. The robot may be used in various educational and operational roles, including learning support, interactive communication, visitor guidance, information sharing, wellbeing reminders, event reception, and customer interaction training. The contracting authority seeks a versatile, user-friendly, and pedagogically effective solution that supports inclusive learning environments and provides long-term value across multiple user groups and educational contexts.,

title: XR-pohjaisen oppimisratkaisun yhteiskehittäminen ja toteutus matkailualan ammatilliseen koulutukseen
description: XR-pohjaisen oppimisratkaisun yhteiskehittäminen ja toteutus matkailualan ammatilliseen koulutukseen 1. Hankinnan tavoite ja kohde Hankinnan kohteena on matkailualan toisen asteen ammatilliseen koulutukseen tarkoitetun pelillisen simulaatio- tai XR-pohjaisen oppimisratkaisun yhteiskehittäminen ja toteuttaminen. Ratkaisun tulee soveltua tarkoituksenmukaisilta osin myös ammattikorkeakouluopetukseen. Hankinta toteutetaan osana Euroopan unionin osarahoittamaa Immersiivisen oppimisen ekosysteemi IMMO-hanketta yhteistyössä Haaga-Helia ammattikorkeakoulun, Helsingin kaupungin ja Laurea-ammattikorkeakoulun kanssa. Tavoitteena on tuottaa IMMO-hankkeen immersiiviseen huonetilaan soveltuva, elämyksellinen ja työelämälähtöinen oppimiskokemus, jonka avulla opiskelijat voivat harjoitella matkailualan tutkinnon osiin ja työelämän osaamistarpeisiin liittyviä tietoja, taitoja ja tilanteita. Ratkaisu voi liittyä yhteen tai useampaan matkailualan osaamisalueeseen. Tarjoajalta ei edellytetä valmista oppimissisältöä tai valmista XR-ratkaisua tarjousvaiheessa, vaan ratkaisun lopulliset sisällöt, oppimistavoitteet ja käyttötapaukset täsmennetään yhteiskehittämisessä. 2. Toimituksen sisältö Hankinta käsittää koko kehitysprosessin suunnittelusta ja konseptoinnista lopulliseen toteutukseen. Toimitukseen sisältyvät vähintään: - vaatimus- ja sisältötyöpajat sekä konseptointi ja käsikirjoitus; - kolme yhteiskehittämistyöpajaa; - oppimis- ja demonstraatioaineistojen rakentaminen; - kehitysversioiden toteuttaminen ja iteratiivinen kehittäminen; - käyttäjätestaukset IMMO-tilassa ja palautteen hyödyntäminen; - ratkaisun viimeistely ja käyttöönottoon liittyvät toimenpiteet; - lähdekoodin, muokattavien lähdetiedostojen, dokumentaation ja muiden sovittujen aineistojen luovuttaminen; ja - loppuraportointi ja avoimen julkaisemisen valmistelu. Yhteiskehittämiseen osallistuu matkailualan opiskelijoita, opettajia, yritysten edustajia ja hankkeen asiantuntijoita. Toimittaja vastaa tarvitsemastaan kehitys- ja testiympäristöstä. Sopimusvelvoitteet suoritetaan EU/ETA-alueella. Toimittajalla on oikeus toteuttaa Ratkaisun suunnittelu, sisällöntuotanto, kehittäminen, ohjelmointi, dokumentointi ja muut toteutustyöt tilariippumattomasti valitsemassaan tarkoituksenmukaisessa ja tietoturvalliseen työskentelyyn soveltuvassa sijainnissa. Asiakkaan tiloissa työskentelyä edellytetään vain siltä osin kuin erikseen sovitut tapaamiset, testaukset, hyväksymismenettelyt tai IMMO-hankkeen immersiivisen huonetilan käyttö sitä edellyttävät. Asiakkaalla ei ole velvollisuutta järjestää Toimittajalle työtiloja. 3. Ratkaisun keskeiset vaatimukset Ratkaisun tulee: - olla pelillinen siten, että pelillisyys on ratkaisun keskeinen suunnitteluperiaate; - mahdollistaa käyttäjän aktiivinen toiminta, päätöksenteko tai ongelmanratkaisu sekä palaute käyttäjän valinnoista; - mahdollistaa oppimiskokemuksen suorittaminen useita kertoja vaihtoehtoisilla tavoilla; - tukea yhteistä oppimista, ryhmätyöskentelyä, opettajajohtoista ohjausta ja useiden käyttäjien samanaikaista osallistumista; - sisältää pedagogisesti perusteltu etenemismalli; - mahdollistaa oppimissisältöjen ylläpito, kehittäminen ja laajentaminen; - täyttää Q/A-liitteessä kuvatut IMMO-tilan tekniset vaatimukset; ja - toimia normaalissa käytössä ilman jatkuvaa tai käytönaikaista internet-yhteyttä. Tavoitteena on noin 20–30 minuutin oppimiskokemus. Tarjoaja voi hyödyntää olemassa olevia teknologioita, pelimoottoreita, XR-alustoja ja 360 asteen sisältöjä, jos kokonaisuus täyttää hankinta-asiakirjoissa asetetut vaatimukset. 4. Toteutus ja aikataulu Toimittajan tulee toteuttaa ratkaisu ketterän ja iteratiivisen kehittämisen periaatteiden mukaisesti. Toimittaja osallistuu marraskuussa 2026 järjestettävään aloituspalaveriin sekä marras- ja joulukuussa järjestettäviin ensimmäisiin yhteiskehittämistyöpajoihin. Ratkaisun eri versioita testataan käyttäjien kanssa IMMO-tilassa tammikuusta 2027 alkaen. Toimittaja osallistuu helmikuussa 2027 toteutettavaan väliarviointiin ja viimeistelee ratkaisun käyttäjäpalautteen perusteella. Lopullinen ratkaisu sisältöineen on toimitettava ja hyväksytettävä viimeistään 28.2.2027. 5. Hinta ja keskeiset sopimusehdot Hankinnan kiinteä kokonaishinta on 35 000 euroa ilman arvonlisäveroa. Hinta sisältää kaikki hankintasopimuksen ja sen liitteiden mukaisten velvoitteiden täyttämisestä aiheutuvat kustannukset. Toimittaja voi laskuttaa hinnan vasta, kun Asiakas on kirjallisesti hyväksynyt lopullisen toimituksen. Toimitukselle annetaan kuuden kuukauden takuu. Toimittajan vastuulla olevasta viivästyksestä voidaan periä sopimuksessa määritelty viivästyssakko. Ratkaisuun sisältyvään tilaajan sovellukseen ja sen dokumentaatioon sovelletaan lähtökohtaisesti EUPL 1.2 -lisenssiä tai muuta etukäteen hyväksyttyä yhteensopivaa avoimen lähdekoodin lisenssiä. Oppimateriaalien oikeudet, käyttö, muokkaaminen, jakaminen ja mahdollinen avoin julkaiseminen ratkaistaan aineistokohtaisesti. Tarjoajan tulee liittää tarjoukseensa alustava Oppimateriaalien oikeus- ja julkaisuluettelo sekä täydentää sitä projektin aikana. Hankkeen tuotosta ei saa julkaista ilman Asiakkaan kirjallista hyväksyntää. Hankintasopimukseen sovelletaan sopimusluonnosta, JIT 2025 Tilaajan sovellukset avoin lähdekoodi -erityisehtoja ja JIT 2025 Yleisiä ehtoja sopimuksessa määrätyssä soveltamisjärjestyksessä. Tarkemmat vähimmäisvaatimukset, tekniset vaatimukset, hyväksymisedellytykset, vastuut ja muut sopimusehdot määräytyvät tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden perusteella.,

title: Special Notice Alternate Design and Delivery Methodologies (ADDM) Candidate Projects
description: 1. Description & Purpose The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Europe District (NAU) is issuing this Special Notice seeking information for acquisition planning purposes as part of its ongoing market research and industry intelligence gathering. 10 U.S.C. �2808a permits transactions other than contracts, grants, or cooperative agreements for facility construction and repair�including planning, design, engineering, prototyping, piloting, and execution. NAU is currently evaluating candidate projects as potential test cases for piloting innovative delivery processes and Alternate Design and Delivery Methodologies (ADDM). These methodologies include Progressive Design-Build (PDB), Design-Build to Budget (DB2B / DBtB), Integrated Design and Construction (IDAC), Construction Manager at Risk (CM@Risk), utilizing Other Transaction Authorities (OTA), evaluated alongside traditional Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) delivery models such as Design-Bid-Build (DBB) and Design-Build. Objectives of this Notice The Government is presenting the basic features, current design status, schedule milestones, funding parameters, and known constraints of three (3) candidate projects. Please note: The Government is not requesting capability assessments, corporate marketing presentations, or expressions of interest in competing for these projects. Rather, NAU is seeking targeted industry perspective and analytical feedback on the following core areas: Fit for ADDM Methodologies: Industry perspectives on which of the identified candidate projects are well-suited for specific ADDM methodologies (e.g., PDB, DBtB/DB2B, use of OTA) and the operational, technical, or contractual reasons supporting that fit. Suitability of Traditional FAR Methodologies: Industry perspectives on whether any of the three candidate projects would be better procured through traditional FAR delivery models (e.g., fully USG-controlled Design-Bid-Build) instead of innovative methodologies. Provide a brief rationale for maintaining traditional delivery. 2. Disclaimer & Market Research Notice Non-Commitment: This notice is published strictly for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP), Invitation for Bids (IFB), or any commitment by the U.S. Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract. No Reimbursement: The Government will not reimburse any costs incurred by industry participants in reviewing this notice, preparing responses, or submitting feedback. Public Releasability & Proprietary Data: Responses to this notice will be treated as public market research. Responding parties are instructed not to submit proprietary information, trade secrets, or protected technologies. Information gathered may be utilized by NAU to inform future acquisition strategies and solicitation development; however, no procurement decisions will be made solely as a result of this notice. 3. Overview of Candidate Projects The three candidate projects under evaluation by USACE Europe District are summarized below based on internal Project Delivery Team (PDT) assessments and engineering reviews. Candidate Project 1: 572070 - FY29 CAP 100672 AFHC Smith Modernization, Baumholder Project Scope: Construct 48 standard design Army Family Housing (AFH) units at Smith Barracks to replace 96 inadequate AFH units. The project constructs four four-story apartment buildings with 12 three-bedroom apartments each. They will be built to meet all current standards. Each apartment building has a ground level garage and four apartments on each of the other three stories. The apartment building includes elevators, a balcony for each apartment, roller shutters and fly screens on each window and balcony door and parking courts on each side of the building that provide access to the ground-level garages. Project includes parking spaces for visitor parking located within close walking distance to the building. Each level in the apartment building is accessible by both elevator and stairs. This project provides new building systems and components to include electrical and mechanical systems, compliance with applicable force protection and energy conservation requirements, balconies, fire alarms/sprinkler systems, elevators, laundry rooms in each apartment, modern kitchens and bathrooms, new efficient heating, plumbing and electrical systems (110 and 220V), TV/telephone/Internet wiring and distribution, built-in closets, doors, windows and storage room. Project includes exterior infrastructure that ties into the existing main utility lines and roadways. It includes connections to storm drainage lines, neighborhood recreational amenities, trash collection enclosures, electrical, water and sewer utility distribution systems and landscaping. It also includes appropriate radon mitigation measures for the new buildings (i.e. installation of a radon tight layer under the floor slab and a passive radon degassing system under the building). An A-E Task Order contract was awarded in FY26 to complete a planning charrette, design charrette, SOW, technical requirements, and required supporting information. Acquisition Schedule: The designer is working on the concept design, with projected completion December 2026. The project is currently indirect (ABG 1 list) and may shift to direct; the regulatory and permitting path is not yet confirmed. Construction magnitude is between $25,000,000 and $100,000,000 Funding: Funded via Army Family Housing Construction (AFHC) appropriations. Candidate Project 2: 581672 - FY27 OMA Repair Enlisted UPH B602, Vilseck Project Scope: Design and repair of Building 602 at Rose Barracks, USAG Bavaria, Vilseck, Germany. The scope of work includes site investigation, DPW coordination, repair SOW development, technical requirements. Repairs may include utilities, foundation, exterior envelope, roof, insulation, windows, doors, interiors, life-safety systems, and other deficiencies identified during development. The project magnitude is between $10,000,000 and $25,000,000. Current Acquisition strategy: DBB. Acquisition Schedule: TBD Funding: Funded via Operations and Maintenance, Army (OMA) appropriations. Candidate Project 3: 578993 - FY28 OMAF B15 SAPF and SCIF Renovation Project Scope: Renovation of B15 facilities and associated utilities at Spangdahlem Air Base, Germany. The project will provide Intelligence Community Directive 705 (ICD-705) compliant secure offices (Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility [SCIF] and Special Access Program Facility [SAPF]), as well as general life safety and support improvements for operational work. Construction consists of renovating two wings of B15 to accommodate the relocation of two distinct mission units: the 52d Fighter Wing Cyber Defense Network (52 FW/CDN) and the 603d Air Operations Center (AOC). Spaces are currently empty and inadequate to support these missions. The project magnitude is between $10,000,000 and $25,000,000; Current Acquisition strategy: DBB. Acquisition Schedule: Procurement of A-E services under the current acquisition strategy to startQ1FY27. Funding: Funded via Facilities Sustainment, Restoration, and Modernization (FSRM) / Operations and Maintenance, Air Force (OMAF) appropriations. 4. title: Technical Assessment and Cost-Benefit Analysis on Fuel Storage Tank Systems Life Cycle (Installation, Maintenance and Removal)
description: Amendment # 001 raised to amend the solicitation closing date and answer questions from industry. Amended the UNSPSC of the Tender Notice. Offers. Canada is seeking offers from Offerors to provide a Technical Assessment and Cost-Benefit Analysis on Fuel Storage Tank Systems Life Cycle (Installation, Maintenance and Removal) to Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) as described in Annex Statement of Work. The technical assessment and cost-benefit analysis will evaluate various options for the installation, maintenance, and decommissioning of storage tank systems and how they align with current industry practices in Canada. The analysis must identify associated environmental impacts, resource requirements, benefits, challenges, and operational and policy risks such as regulatory misalignment, compliance barriers, or unintended socioeconomic consequences that go beyond environmental considerations. This includes considerations for both the regulated community and key industry stakeholders such as certified installers, professional engineers, project managers, consultants, and manufacturers. The Contractor must assess the most common and practical procedures currently used in the industry for the installation, maintenance, including leak detection options, and decommissioning of various types of storage tank systems located in Canada. The Contractor must review applicable requirements under the National Fire Code of Canada (NFCC), CSA B139 Installation Code for Oil-Burning Equipment, the CCME Code of Practice, and any other authority having jurisdiction (AHJ) with best requirements for protecting against fuel contamination. Term. The period of the Contract is from date of Contract (est. October 1, 2026) to December 31, 2027, inclusive. Resource Categories The resource categories (roles)* required are as follows: 1. Licensed Professional Engineer 2. Petroleum Storage Tank System Technician 3. Petroleum Storage Tank Systems Compliance Specialist 4. Project Manager *As part of its proposed Project Team, the Offeror can propose the same resource for any of the resource categories required, with the exception that the Licensed Professional Engineer cannot be the same proposed resource as the Petroleum Storage Tank System Technician. Note to Offerors: The proposed resource title (resource categories) in Annex Technical Criteria are descriptive labels intended solely to indicate the nature of the expertise required. They do not represent formal occupational classifications or restrict the number of resources proposed, the allocation of responsibilities, or the manner in which an Offeror structures its Project Team.

description: 1. Background: Space Systems Command Space Reconnaissance and Surveillance Branch (SSC/SYZ) is finalizing the SG-XX communication architecture requirements and requests industry information on possible high Technology Readiness Level (TRL) solutions to support the constellation of SG-XX vehicles. SG-XX is a planned super sync geo-based surveillance system comprised of a proliferated constellation of free flyer space vehicles (SVs) with Wide Field of View (WFOV) Electro-Optical (EO) payload(s) capable of wide-area volume search and track. The primary objective of this proliferated constellation will be to scan, track, and detect Resident Space Objects (RSO's) in and around the geosynchronous orbit geo-belt. The data collected must be delivered to the operational community in near real time to support warfighter requirements. The government has performed communication architectures studies and has determined a SG-XX to SG-XX cross link solution will provide the timeliness required to ensure mission data delivery over the entire geo-belt. The SG-XX constellation will operate in an evenly spaced �string of pearls� configuration at a TBD altitude above the geo-belt. The cross link may operate in either half-duplex or full-duplex mode between each satellite. The SG-XX satellite may slew throughout the day to meet the scan requirements and thus the communication subsystem must include antennas that can maintain the link through nominal slew rates. The solution must incorporate the capability to manage the data flow of each communication element across the constellation of SG-XX satellites. This RFI is only seeking information related to a radio frequency (RF) V-Band cross link solutions, please do not submit alternative communications subsystem (e.g. optical, other RF bands, or geo to ground) solutions or capabilities related to SG-XX buses or payload that may not improve the information requested as part of this RFI. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information and planning purposes (market research). Furthermore, the Government is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept any unsolicited proposals. All RF cross link designs that meet the requirements are of interest; however, the Government is seeking industry experience with operational or very mature builds nearing final design/environmental qualification that incorporate V-Band radio frequency solutions. Government is seeking recent (?5 years) and relevant demonstrated success with low/moderate cost, build/production (?2 (preferred) year communication payload builds) of subsystem performing the mission described in section 3b and 3c is desired, which may include final build/environmental testing that is underway, modified existing space qualified design, or already fielded. title: Precision Inertial Navigation & Positioning On an Integrated Tesseract (PINPOINT)
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) is soliciting innovative proposals in the following technical area: physics and nonlinear control of inertial measurement units (IMUs) appropriate for tactical and unmanned missions. The Precision Inertial Navigation & Positioning On an Integrated Tesseract (PINPOINT) program will challenge the research community to overcome the decade-long performance plateau of micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) IMUs by exploring revolutionary sensor architectures that operate in highly nonlinear regimes. DARPA is soliciting proposals for the research and development of novel inertial sensors based on physics such as, but not limited to, electromagnetically levitated proof masses, non-linear resonators, and high-velocity tethered microsystems. A central theme of this program is the tight co-design of the physical sensor package with advanced, real-time adaptive control systems necessary to stabilize and harness these complex dynamics. Performers should investigate innovative approaches that enable revolutionary advances in science, devices, or systems. Specifically excluded is research that primarily results in evolutionary improvements to the existing state of practice.
